# Dzen

> > Dzen is a content discovery and publishing platform operated by Yandex, featuring personalized content recommendations and user-generated articles.

Dzen (formerly Yandex.Zen) serves as Yandex's content platform for readers and creators. The site uses Yandex SmartCaptcha and Yandex Cloud infrastructure to protect against automated access and ensure platform security.

## Key Topics

- Yandex
- SmartCaptcha
- Yandex Cloud
- dzen.ru
- captcha
- bot-detection
- security
- access-verification
- automated-requests
- verification
- access-control
